bayts.text: O Book of the Generous, you are my beloved and my intimate, and you were before my physician.
You are my glory and my pride, you are my standing, you are my treasure, O pride of every intelligent one.
O Messenger of the Generous, you are my imām: you guarded what is above me, below me, behind me, before me.
My Lord repelled the Accursed from my side through you, humiliating him; and he sought my death.
My Lord repelled the Accursed from everything He chose for me, through His Chosen, my hero.
Allah has turned forever toward the Followed, from Himself, the best peace: what an excellent imām is mine!
O Book that spared the enemies and the seas, leading houris to whoever loves you,
you are my provision toward the Gardens and my light: you have already repelled the Accursed, and increased (his) banishment.
O Book that spared the enemies and toil, through which I was granted good pleasure and sufficiency,
you are my companionship in secret and openly, perpetually: through you I praise God with praise.
O Book of the Generous, you are my beloved and my intimate, and before you were my physician.
You are my treasure in this world and the Next, and my standing; you are my glory, O glory of every intelligent one.
O Book through which I converse intimately with an Answerer Who leads to me what gladdens the noble,
through you I please God with the pleasing of one well pleased, and He shortly leads a marvel toward me.
O Book that effaced harm and the veil, God leads to me in you the answering.
Drive harm and evil toward others than me perpetually, and lead to me what lasts, marvellous.
I have sought the peace of my King, after the blessing, for him whom You led to Him, answered.
